claim.value: Accounts whose roster dates are unknown should have a fixed maximum follow-up.
claim.scope: Conditional on an unknown roster date; the maximum duration is unspecified.

provenance.rationale: The span directly supplies the unknown-date condition and fixed maximum follow-up rule.

signal_basis.value: Observation ends at declared follow-up limits, with unfinished trajectories marked as censored and accounts with no return or incomplete follow-up reported alongside published accounts.
signal_basis.scope: A fixed maximum applies when the roster date is unknown; reaching that limit does not establish abandonment or absence of benefit.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the observation boundary, censoring and reporting requirements, and limits on interpreting incomplete trajectories.
The claim is supported as a bounded observation rule without requiring an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: An unknown roster date cannot anchor roster-relative follow-up. A fixed maximum supplies an executable observation boundary, while censoring preserves the distinction between observation ending and an account reaching an outcome. This licenses the stated procedural rule within its limits.
uncertainty: The mapping does not establish an optimal maximum duration or guarantee that outcomes will be resolved by that time; neither is claimed.
